svg.text: Installed MK4S hotend, millimetres. Left: plan view from above, through the block (up the page = toward the back,
left = the robot's left). Dark: the standard PETG coupon (482 cells of 0.5 mm, fixture/coupon-cells.csv). Red/white: leads.
Block 13 x 20, turned 35 degrees. Coupon: inset 0.5 mm from the block edges, a 3 mm bare strip
along the lead-exit face (dashed red), a 4.5 mm radius hole round the nozzle (dashed circle); 120 mm2.
Coupon outline in block axes (x' toward the lead face): x' -6.0 to 3.5, y' -9.5 to 9.5, less the hole.
M4 rods, nuts set the height
lab jack on the build plate
Raise until the coupon meets the underside; hold the 4 min
250 C pre-heat; lower below nozzle tip, then withdraw.
